description: Fetch one scheduled task by id: its project, name, prompt, triggers (schedule), labels, template key, skip-if-previous-open setting, enabled state, and next/last run times. An id outside the caller's accessible projects returns not found. For what each fire produced, use list_scheduled_task_runs.

scheduledTaskId.description: Scheduled task id, e.g. from list_scheduled_tasks

name: get_scheduled_task
title: Get scheduled task
